Resolves #21211

🌿 What the engine's build runs no longer depends on a third party's default branch on the day it runs.

`buildScripts/build/highlightJs.mjs` now bundles the installed, lockfile-pinned `highlight.js` (11.12.0) with esbuild, as `parse5.mjs` does. It writes the same two files to the same paths with the same ten languages, and needs no git, no network and no second install. Related: #21213.

Evidence: L3 (a forced build on this machine; the dev-mode Portal read in headless Chromium) → L3 required (AC-5, AC-6). Residual: AC-7, Residual-Owner: neomjs/create-app#61.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1: no `git`, no `npm`, no network; `highlight.js` in `devDependencies` and the lockfile | CI: `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/highlightJs.spec.mjs`, "the script runs no git clone and no second install: it imports no child_process". The diff adds `"highlight.js": "^11.12.0"` and its single lockfile entry. |
| AC-2: both files are ES modules registering exactly the ten languages | CI: the same spec, one arm per file; a second arm per file finds the installed package's `LICENSE` verbatim |
| AC-3: the skip and `-f, --force` are unchanged | CI: "the CLI checks the consumer working directory for an existing bundle"; the option and the skip are untouched |
| AC-4: a spec builds into a temporary folder, one `highlight()` per language; the clone's tests are gone | CI: the same spec |
| AC-5: `npm run build-highlightjs -- -f` under 2 s | 0.22 s wall clock on an Apple M5 Max, npm start-up included, at `50872b1bd2` too. Minified 71,092 bytes, unminified 140,380: the ticket's probe sizes (69,545 and 138,833) plus the 1,547-byte license banner. |
| AC-6: a code-fenced guide in the Portal shows highlighted code in dev mode | `PORT=8098 npm run server-start -- --no-open`, then headless Chromium (Playwright) on `#/learn/guides/advanced/CanvasArchitecture`: 17 `<pre>` blocks, 278 `hljs-*` spans, a keyword in `rgb(255, 123, 114)`. The server served the new 138,833-byte `dist/highlight/highlight.custom.js` (at `54b5167160`, before the banner). |
| AC-7: post-merge, the generator's devDependencies carry `highlight.js` | Post-Merge Validation; neomjs/create-app#61 owns it on cut day |

## Deltas from ticket
- The spec imports each bundle in a child Node process. Imported inside the Playwright worker, the bundle's default export had no `listLanguages`; plain Node gets `hljs`, which is what a browser gets.
- The no-`child_process` arm is a top-level test, so it can run alone: the bundle arms share a `beforeAll` that fails on the old script.
- Both bundles open with the installed package's version and `LICENSE` file (`licenseBanner()`). Upstream's build tool used to prepend a short banner; bundling with esbuild dropped it until Round 1 found it.

## Test Evidence
- Red on `dev`'s script: the no-`child_process` arm alone fails, and the bundle arms fail in their `beforeAll` (`buildBundle` is not a function).
- Local, on this branch: the whole unit suite, 7,864 passed and 2 skipped; `check-package-contents` OK; `check-file-sizes` 0 violations.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] With the release, the generator's devDependencies carry `highlight.js` (neomjs/create-app#61), so a workspace on Engine 14 builds the bundle.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the shared baseline jobs run.
